source.check: All names and figures read on the Irish News, 2 June 1961, p. 1 (results by division with majority, spoiled votes, total poll and electorate); fuller forenames from the nominations, BNL 17 May 1961 p. 5 (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026).

note: Triennial election of Castlereagh Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Six of the nine seats were contested. Of the six sitting official Unionists who faced contests only three held their seats: Castlereagh went to Labour, Ballyhackamore to the Tenants' Association and Ballycultra to an unofficial Unionist. Tenants' Association gain from Unionist. The Irish News prints total poll 620 and the News-Letter 629; the votes and three spoiled papers support 620, but the discrepancy is recorded here rather than reconciled.
